title: Pain in Right Arm
diagnosis: Colles' Fracture of Right Arm / Domestic Abuse
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} presents with right wrist pain, swelling, and deformity after a reported fall. X-ray reveals a Colles' fracture — distal radius fracture with dorsal angulation (dinner fork deformity). However, the mechanism of injury and clinical presentation raise concern for domestic abuse. The physician must recognize red flags: inconsistent history, delay in seeking care, pattern of injuries in various stages of healing, and accompanying fearfulness or avoidance. Management: closed reduction and casting/splinting for the fracture. But equally important: a safety assessment, documentation of injuries, and referral to social work or appropriate support services. Domestic violence screening should be done privately and sensitively.
chief_complaint: Right wrist pain, swelling, and deformity after fall

stacks.label: Closed reduction + casting/splinting
stacks.finding: Colles' fracture management: closed reduction under hematoma block or sedation, then immobilization in sugar-tong splint or short arm cast.

stacks.label: Orthopedic follow-up
stacks.finding: Serial X-rays to ensure reduction maintained.

stacks.finding: Suspected domestic abuse. Screen privately. Document findings. Refer to social services. Safety planning.

stacks.label: Reassure patient / Counseling
stacks.finding: Create safe, non-judgmental space. Provide domestic violence resources.

decoys.label: Surgical fixation (ORIF) first-line for Colles'
decoys.reason_wrong: Closed reduction and casting is first-line for Colles' fracture. Surgery reserved for intra-articular fractures, significant comminution, or failed closed reduction.

teach_me_steps.order: Recognize Colles' fracture: dinner fork deformity + dorsal angulation
teach_me_steps.reasoning: Distal radius fracture with dorsal displacement. Common in FOOSH (fall on outstretched hand). X-ray confirms. Check median nerve.
Hematoma block or sedation → reduce → sugar-tong splint/short arm cast. Orthopedic follow-up for serial X-rays.
Red flags: inconsistent history, delay, multiple injuries in various stages. Screen PRIVATELY. Document. Social work consult. Safety planning.

case_summary: Colles' fracture (dinner fork deformity) in setting of suspected domestic abuse. Closed reduction + casting. Social work consult + DV screening. Ortho follow-up.
